work.name: Canada West Land
work.summary: Software and AI-focused technologist building internal APIs, production agents, and automation tooling on Azure alongside enterprise geospatial delivery.
highlights: Deploy internal-facing APIs on Azure — App Service web apps, Azure Functions for event- and schedule-triggered jobs, and API Management for gateway routing, auth, and rate limiting — shipped via Azure DevOps with Repos code review, Pipelines CI/CD, and Doppler-managed secrets.
Designed and deployed role-specific internal agents on Microsoft Foundry, grounded on internal company data and wired to internal APIs and tool actions; now in daily production use by colleagues.

Contributed to an internal Azure-hosted production app for agentic AI workflows using LangChain, LangGraph, and n8n with role-specific system-prompt design, cutting selected full-day manual processes to 1–2 hours.

Build and maintain internal geospatial tooling through agentic CLI development (Claude Code, Codex) with repo-scoped agent context and hook automation, replacing manual ETL, QC, and map-production steps; several of these methods are now standard on the team. Prototyped self-hosted long-running agent runtimes with cross-session state and remote triggers.

Key contributor on a large-scale enterprise GIS delivery for a major client: own a six-map production workstream and its end-to-end ETL and data-cleaning pipelines (Python, Esri APIs, FME) across datasets of roughly 5,000 to 1M records.

work.name: University of Calgary
work.summary: Led capstone delivery for a geospatial mapping study, building the Python processing and validation pipeline used to compare survey methods against photogrammetry-derived spatial datasets.

work.name: Gongcha
work.summary: Managed high-volume shift operations and trained staff on standardized workflows, strengthening team coordination and execution under time constraints.

projects.name: Glass Atlas: Source-Grounded RAG Knowledge Site
projects.description: Deployed SvelteKit 2 (Svelte 5 runes) site that turns a personal note library into a conversational, citation-backed assistant.
highlights: Engineered hybrid semantic + lexical retrieval over Neon PostgreSQL with pgvector and Drizzle ORM, with confidence-tiered fallbacks that keep every answer grounded in source notes.
Built streaming RAG chat through OpenRouter (Gemini 2.0 Flash) on 1536-dim text-embedding-3-small vectors, strictly typed end to end in TypeScript.
Shipped on Railway with a Bun HTTP server, Auth.js GitHub OAuth, and private S3-compatible storage via presigned URLs.

projects.name: PigeonCoop: Local-First Agent Workflow Engine
projects.description: Rust/Tauri desktop app for designing, running, monitoring, and replaying coding-agent workflows against local repositories.
highlights: Designed Rust core crates for typed workflow definitions, RunEvent envelopes, deterministic run/node state machines, and SQLite-backed workflow, run, and event persistence.
Built runtime adapters that drive real coding-agent CLIs, plus a React/TypeScript graph workspace with Agent, Tool, Router, Memory, and Human Review nodes and pre-run validation.
Covered builder, live-run, human-review, and replay flows with Rust unit tests, React component tests, and WebdriverIO/Tauri end-to-end suites.

projects.name: Weather & Wellness: UBC Research Platform
highlights: Built a Next.js 15 / React 19 frontend and FastAPI backend that auto-scores validated instruments (digit span, loneliness, depression, anxiety) in real time.
Architected per-lab data isolation on Supabase Postgres/Auth with Upstash Redis, and mixed-effects weather-psychology modelling via statsmodels.
